text:
anya: Heads-up — eu-south reserved pool is seeing a sustained queue spike, admission rate dropped to ~30% over the last 6m.
kevin: seeing it too in the dashboard. p50 latency up 2.4x, queue length at 260.
sam: any change in incoming QPS patterns? customer commits?
anya: traffic is normal by origin, looks like internal scheduling pressure + a few long-running batch in reserved-eusouth-1 pool.
maria: checked allocation: 6 A100_80GB nodes are at 98% mem due to two heavy finetune jobs. eviction priority shows them as "reserved-batch-high".
luz: those finetunes were supposed to be pre-emptible. why didn't autoscaler evict?
autoscaler-bot: [INFO] 2026-03-18T14:11:22Z - scaleDownPolicy skipped eviction for jobs with tag: "reserved-batch-high".
kevin: ok that's why. we set that tag for committed customers last quarter. need a temporary policy to protect latency SLOs.
sam: propose: 1) soft-evict non-critical finetunes in reserved-eusouth-1 (grace 2m), 2) enable spillover routing to eu-west for new admits, 3) bump per-tenant rate-limits for affected dedicated customers to keep fairness.
anya: +1. add note that spillover will incur inter-region egress and slightly higher latency. notify support.
maria: I can trigger soft-evict. command I'll run: `rctl evict --pool reserved-eusouth-1 --tag reserved-batch-high --grace 120s --dry-run=false`
luz: also flip routing flag: `config service-routing set --pool reserved-eusouth-1 --spillover eu-west --mode emergency`
autoscaler-bot: [ACTION] 2026-03-18T14:14:05Z - initiated soft-evict for 3 jobs (ids: j-8342, j-8343, j-8347)
kevin: jobs draining. queue dropped to 80 in 90s. admission bumped to 65%.
sam: created incident ticket INC-2026-3224 and added runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/reserved-pool-spillover.md
anya: support ping: @support-team please prepare customer comms for affected tenants (expect transient failures, optional retry advise).
maria: cost note: if spillover > 30% for >1hr we should warn finance — inter-region burst costs escalate.
kevin: agreed. monitoring alert: set temp burn-rate alert at 30% above baseline for eu-south->eu-west egress.
luz: after soft-evict and spillover we should schedule a follow-up to identify why those finetunes were tagged non-preemptible.
anya: thanks all — will keep thread updated. current status: mitigation applied, admission ~72%, queue ~45, watch for reaccumulation. :eyes:
